title: Unified toolbar background (window title bar strip)

source.container: plain PNG resource in the framework

media.colorspace: sRGB (assumed from GameKit resource conventions; unverified)

reproduction.recipe: Render as a 44 pt tall strip: 1 px top highlight line at 35 % white, body #d9d9d9 -> #ececec vertical gradient, 1 px bottom hairline at 45 % black, flat centre so the strip tiles horizontally. Cap insets must be re-derived from the original after the tile seam is found (the 320 px width is a tile width, not a minimum width).
checks: pixel delta <= 2/255 per channel against the original capture
seam invisible at 3 different window widths

legal.notes: Original PNG stays in the guest; only derived measurements and our own drawing enter this repo (UI_REFERENCE rule C5).

provenance.artifact_sha256: external-guest-derived; commit hash recorded by tests/uiref/test_catalog.py
provenance.notes: w/h/format/alpha are the decoded header values of the real 10.9 resource. Everything under 'rendering' and 'reproduction' is MavLinOS engineering until the cap insets are measured.

gaps.what: cap insets / seamless tile boundary of the 320 px strip

notes: This is a GameKit resource, not an AppKit one: Mavericks' own X toolbars are drawn by AppKit (NSToolbar), so this asset is a FALLBACK for toolbars we cannot draw procedurally, not the canonical Finder toolbar.
